title: cicuta douglasii var. occidentalis
intro: Cicuta douglasii var. occidentalis, commonly known as Western Water Hemlock, is a highly toxic and deadly plant species native to North America. Despite its toxic nature, it has been studied for potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing pain and inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Western Water Hemlock include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial activity, and exhibit antioxidant activity. Bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, such as cicutoxin, and glycosides, which contribute to its toxic effects and potential therapeutic benefits.
